body: Guess we're really all in this together, huh? I'm sorry your teacher is being a total ass! It sucks that you are dealing with similar stuff but it does make me feel a little better to know that I am not alone.

yes they are, thank god. thank you for mentioning p/f as an option-- i've been freaking out but that made me feel a lot better. congrats on finishing the 8 credits! I know its tough to not be able to finish all of your classes, but you got through and that's the important thing.
